description: The deposit provides training data for a Group Method of Data Handling model of gas compressibility. It identifies AGA8-92DC as the generator of the training values. The provider is Shi Yang Li and coauthors. Coverage: The page does not establish mixture ranges, pressure or temperature bounds, sample count, geography or an observation period. The values are generated for a modelling study. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The provider states CC BY NC 3.0. Commercial reuse is restricted. Limitations: A training dataset derived from an equation of state is not an independent empirical validation dataset. Its parameter domain must be checked before use. For simulation it may support surrogate thermodynamic-property calculations within a gas-flow model. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
